help.title: Taimako da Tallafi
help.headerTitle: Ta yaya za mu taimake ka?
help.headerSubtitle: Nemo amsoshin tambayoyin gama-gari ko ka tuntuɓe mu.

ai.question: Ta yaya zan yi amfani da Edutu AI?
ai.answer: Za ka iya shiga Edutu AI daga maɓallin tsakiya na mashigin kewayawa. Kawai ka rubuta tambayarka game da kwasa-kwasai, jagorar sana'a, ko ƙwarewa, zai taimaka maka nan take.

enroll.question: Ta yaya zan shiga kwas?
enroll.answer: Je zuwa shafin 'Market', nemo kwas ɗin da kake sha'awa, ka danna 'Access Now'. Wasu kwasa-kwasai suna buƙatar Kirediti, wasu kuma kyauta ne.

credits.question: Ta yaya zan samu Kirediti?
credits.answer: Za ka iya samun Kirediti ta hanyar shiga fitattun damammaki, kammala ayyuka, ko bayar da gudummawa a matsayin mai ƙirƙira. Duba walat ɗinka don ƙarin bayani.

security.question: Shin bayanaina suna da tsaro?
security.answer: Eh, muna amfani da ɓoye-ɓoye na matakin masana'antu da Clerk don tantancewa domin tabbatar da kariyar bayanan ka da ci gaban karatunka a koyaushe.

privacy.title: Manufar Sirri
privacy.notice: Ta amfani da Edutu, ka amince da sharuɗɗan hidimarmu da wannan manufar sirri. Ba mu taɓa sayar da bayanan ka ga wasu ba.

dataWeCollect.title: Bayanan da Muke Tattarawa
dataWeCollect.desc: Muna tattara sunanka, email, da ci gaban karatunka don keɓance kwarewar koyonka da bin diddigin manufofinka.

howWeUseIt.title: Yadda Muke Amfani da Su
howWeUseIt.desc: Bayanan ka suna taimaka mana mu ba ka shawarar kwasa-kwasai, mu ba da jagorar AI, mu kuma tabbatar kana samun Kirediti kan nasarorinka.

dataProtection.title: Kariyar Bayanai
dataProtection.desc: Duk bayanan kai an ɓoye su. Muna amfani da ƙa'idojin tsaro na matakin masana'antu don kare bayanan ka daga shiga mara izini.

yourRights.title: Haƙƙoƙinka
yourRights.desc: Za ka iya neman goge asusunka ko sauke bayanan ka a kowane lokaci ta cibiyar taimakonmu ko ta tuntuɓar tallafi.
